craft_notes: Sthāyin: atom-joy. Two whole-pāda fusions sung whole. Close: giving. Rejected: 'monad' — killed.

lines: The atom soon attains pure lordly knowing;
its mover Śiva to be known, all-knowing, bestowing.
l4.sanskrit_cite: aṇurviśuddhamacirādaiśvaraṃ jñānamaśnute taccodakaḥ śivo jñeyaḥ sarvajñaḥ parameśvaraḥ |

reads_against.argmap: The atom soon reaches pure lordly knowing; its impeller Śiva, all-knowing lord, to be known.
c1_essence: Atom reaches lordly knowing; impeller Śiva to be known.
